verdict.rationale: Bitbucket docs explicitly state you can use built-in Pipelines 'or connect Bitbucket Cloud to on-prem CI/CD tools like Bamboo or Jenkins,' directly confirming external CI/CD integration as an alternative to native pipelines. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of setting up Jenkins/Bamboo integration and broader detail on other third-party CI/CD tool support beyond Bamboo/Jenkins.
